paragraphs: The Discovery P400 is part of the fifth-generation Discovery range (D5, codename L462), introduced in 2017 and continuing through to the present day. The P400 uses the Ingenium AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid technology. It sits above the P360 in the Discovery petrol range, offering higher output while sharing the same basic Ingenium architecture. As with all modern Ingenium petrol engines, the AJ300P is generally regarded as more reliable than its diesel counterparts, though cooling system maintenance remains important.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P (Ingenium 3.0L I6) engines for every Discovery P400 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine fitted to the Discovery P400 from 2017 to present (D5/L462 generation). The AJ300P is part of JLR's Ingenium engine family and features mild-hybrid (MHEV) technology. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
